decisions.reason: The location-based margin analysis builds directly on the firm's maintained market-data databases and tariff know-how, and it kept its own page in 2024, so the firm can interpret its results and refine it within the expanding central platform.

The regional electricity tariff calculator sits close to the core tariff-calculation competence, so it is cheap to maintain and easy to improve, even though its drop from a dedicated page to a mention and the removal of sibling calculators B, D and F point to consolidation.

The regional area definition tool draws on the firm's network and location data and likely serves as a building block for other location-based analyses on the platform, so keeping it fits the firm's knowledge base despite its reduced visibility.
